message.content: ATP synthase (also called F₁F₀‑ATPase) is the enzyme complex in the inner mitochondrial membrane that synthesizes ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. It uses the proton gradient generated by the electron transport chain: protons flow back into the mitochondrial matrix through the F₀ portion, driving rotation of the catalytic F₁ head. This mechanical rotation induces conformational changes that convert ADP + Pi into ATP, making ATP synthase the primary energy‑generating machine of aerobic cells.
